summary: Re-audit under T-02.2 rubric: DDL idempotence, source_claim trigger immutability, completeness table constraints.

fail_cases_tested: BR-06: UPDATE on source_claim fails with BR-06 violation trigger abort
BR-06: DELETE on source_claim fails with BR-06 violation trigger abort
INV-GR-01: Extractor called with onTurnPath: true throws INV-GR-01 error

findings.description: PostgreSQL RLS DDL script is maintained separately in POSTGRES_RLS_SQL and tested via emulation; ensure CI pipeline runs PG container test for native RLS.

invariants_checked.evidence: Heavy queries detected via isTurnSafe() and pushed off-path via dispatchQuery() into async queue without blocking turn; verified in qc/eso-graph-offpath.test.mjs
AST nodes (graph_node) and static edges (graph_edge) serve as single source of truth in eso/graph/src/schema.mjs
All tables include project NOT NULL; PostgreSQL RLS policies defined in POSTGRES_RLS_SQL
Completeness value is always numeric NOT NULL; incomplete coverage yields status 'unknown' with coverage ratio, never 'absent'
source_claim table has NO parallel sources column; SQLite triggers reject UPDATE and DELETE
initSchema() uses IF NOT EXISTS for all tables, indexes, and triggers; verified by executing initSchema twice consecutively
